//: Only what scripts/check-route-coverage.mjs cannot derive from the tree. A route's specs and captures are read from the path literals in e2e/ (see that script); an entry here adds `e2e` specs and `visual` captures that reach the route by clicks a literal cannot show, or an `exempt` reason saying why the route warrants less than both. `node scripts/check-route-coverage.mjs --write` prunes it; it never adds an exemption.

/ready/[token]/party/[seatId]/waiver.exempt: The same waiverSigningForm the waiver link draws, which the waiver captures photograph with its guardian card; only the door differs. guardian-co-signature.spec.ts reaches this page by the party panel's Sign tap, and src/app/(token)/ready/[token]/party-waiver-actions.test.ts holds the door against a real record (issue #2743).

/ready/[token]/party/[seatId]/waiver/doc.exempt: The same DoctorReferralBody the diver's own doctor's page draws, held against a real record by src/app/(token)/ready/[token]/waiver/doctor/page.test.ts; only the door differs, and that door (the lead's readiness link, the panel's physician door on the seat, the referral gate) is held against a real record by src/app/(token)/ready/[token]/party-waiver-actions.test.ts (issue #2743).

/shop/[shopSlug]/safety/print.exempt: No capture of its own yet: the sheet is the Safety screen's figures and lists on a PacketSheet, held figure for figure against the screen by src/app/shop/[shopSlug]/safety/print/page.test.tsx and row for row by SafetyLists.test.tsx, and reports.spec.ts opens it from the Print door. Its first baseline is cut in the visual-print layer (issue #2745).

/shop/[shopSlug]/trips/[id]/party/[leadI.exempt: The same DoctorReferralSheet the diver's doctor's page prints, which the waiver-doctor capture photographs; only the door differs (the desk's counter queue, issue #3984), and src/features/party-waiver-queue/store.test.ts holds its reader (getCounterDoctorReferral) against a real record: the seat on the queue, waiting on a physician, its answers off the paper.
